name: @ivanbbaev/facebook-mcp
description: Local-first TypeScript MCP server for the Meta Graph API that lets an MCP client publish, read and moderate Facebook Pages through your own Meta developer app, with least-privilege tokens, plan-and-apply write safety and no telemetry.
author: Ivan Baev <ivanbbaev@gmail.com>

scripts.guard:no-install-scripts: node -e "const s=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('package.json','utf8')).scripts||{};const bad=['preinstall','install','postinstall','prepare'].filter(k=>k in s);if(bad.length){console.error('Policy violation: package.json declares install lifecycle script(s): '+bad.join(', ')+'. This package runs no code at install time; the post-install check is the doctor subcommand, run by the user.');process.exit(1)}console.log('no install lifecycle scripts declared - ok')"
scripts.check: npm run guard:no-install-scripts && npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run build && npm run test
scripts.preversion: node -e "console.error('Refusing: do not bump the version with npm version. scripts/metadata.config.mjs is the version SSOT and npm run metadata re-stamps package.json from it, silently reverting the bump. Edit identity.version there, then run npm run metadata. See docs/runbooks/release.md.');process.exit(1)"
scripts.prepublishOnly: node -e "if(!process.env.GITHUB_ACTIONS&&process.env.ALLOW_LOCAL_PUBLISH!=='1'){console.error('Refusing: publishing happens in .github/workflows/release.yml, triggered by a v*.*.* tag, never from a laptop. The one documented exception is the first-ever publish that reserves the npm name (docs/runbooks/release.md, One-time setup); for that, and only that, set ALLOW_LOCAL_PUBLISH=1.');process.exit(1)}"
